roles.title: Graduate Trainee — Data Science
bullets: Primary developer of a procurement audit platform on Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP data, authoring 28 of its 38 exception checks across procure-to-pay, vendor master data, and access rights.
Flagged near-duplicate line items by pairing fuzzy and Levenshtein similarity with a cross-encoder NLP model, and containerised and scheduled the pipeline with Docker and APScheduler.
On other projects, developed ETL pipelines and Power BI and Tableau dashboards, designed ER diagrams, authored technical documentation, and supported client teams in resolving data issues.

roles.title: Data Scientist Intern
bullets: Worked with MongoDB and PyMongo, and built a REST API with Flask, validated using Postman and documented with Swagger UI.
Applied Python and Pandas for data cleaning, transformation, and feature engineering, including a pipeline that improved predictive workflows within a microservices framework.
Collaborated with UI/UX and frontend teams to take a dashboard from wireframe to production.

roles.title: Freelance — Full Stack Developer
bullets: Main contributor to HiSalon, the company's multi-tenant salon management SaaS, and contributed to HiPay and HiChat, mostly through an agent-driven workflow with Claude Code.
On HiPay, a payment gateway, fixed the checkout and SDK for Apple Pay, BENEFIT, and Flooss.
On HiChat, a customer experience platform, fixed WhatsApp campaigns and phone number handling, and let agents reopen expired chats with approved templates.

roles.title: Data Analyst Intern
bullets: Performed data analysis, visualisation, and reporting in Microsoft Power BI to support business intelligence initiatives.
Built dashboards to highlight key performance metrics, cost drivers, and trends.
